title: Making complex CFTs real: The two-dimensional Potts model for Q>4 and complex Q
abstract: Transfer-matrix plus analytic-continuation recipe to extract conformal data (central charge, exponents, OPE coefficients) from a lattice spectrum, for the 2D Potts model at Q>4 and complex Q.
key_claims: Reads conformal data off the lattice/transfer-matrix spectrum (not energy) -- the same lesson that fixed the chi=6 wrong-basin problem.
Candidate tooling to sharpen Delta_sigma at chi=6 (0.154 vs CFT 0.075) IF adapted to the minimal-model/TCI tower.
